description.narrative: This 18-month measure will provide equipment and assistance in response to urgent needs in the context of the evolving situation of Ukrainian territories liberated from Russian military occupation. This will include assistance to the restoration of access to justice and the re-establishment of public safety and order, for example, by supporting the regional police offices, the prosecutor general, and other relevant authorities through the provision of equipment and flanking measures that act as enabler to their work.
